en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the façade of the National Theatre building in Cluj, with statues atop its towers and the inscription "Teatrul National" on the pediment. The reverse is printed with multilingual captions naming the theatre in Cluj and bears Romanian People's Republic postage stamps (35 bani and 5 bani), Bucharest postmarks, a handwritten Romanian message and an address in București.
